name: kxgoldmon
title: Gold price on October 30, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT?
settlement: Resolves YES if the close price of the 1-minute candlestick for gold on October 30, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT is above 4912.99 USD/t.oz. The 5:00 PM candle close reflects trading from 4:59:00-4:59:59 PM. If no data is published, the most recently available data is used.
decideContext: You are estimating the effect of a news item on the spot/futures price of gold (USD per troy ounce) at the specific 1-minute close timestamp of 5:00 PM EDT on October 30, 2026. The market resolves YES if that price is above the strike level; focus on whether the news plausibly pushes gold's price up or down and by roughly how much before that snapshot.
